lookup.body: The unchanged complete controller-v2 form payload; no extra manifest fields.
lookup.side_effects: Read cache metadata and issue an opaque lookup token only. Never run a solver, publish a job or process the cube.

semantics.intervals: Inclusive calendar dates; missing range days count both endpoints. Overall ranges summarize dates, not solver work across four candidates; candidate details are authoritative.
semantics.family: Same semantic start, scenario, initialization and baseline state, master/source/forecast versions, inquiry tranches, penalties, solver settings and random identities. Volatile UUIDs are not semantic identity. Backend owns canonicalization and fingerprinting.
semantics.overall_action: ERROR if blocked; otherwise NEW if any candidate is NEW, else EXTEND if any is EXTEND, else REUSE. Four distinct candidate decisions are required for submission.
semantics.extension: EXTEND is allowed only when backend has verified the appropriate checkpoint and continuation semantics; existing published runs stay immutable.
semantics.reuse: Source RunKeys are provenance. A shorter requested interval requires a distinct cutoff-safe projection; never return final source-run outcomes as the shorter result.

submit.backend_rule: Revalidate payload, dependency identities and cache coverage under the submission lock. Never rely on a client action or source RunKey.

stale_body.error: The cache decision changed; review and submit again.

submit.reuse_queue: REUSE may queue SQL requested-window projection and cube processing. No DES/MILP execution is implied; poll the compatible status endpoint.

result.result_scope: start/end/as_of_end must equal the accepted requested range; source full intervals and RunKeys may be included separately as provenance.
result.window_results: Backend-produced candidate KPIs/order state truncated or recomputed at requested end. UI renders only this projection for REUSE/EXTEND, never the old full result.json.
result.legacy: Historical outputs without a bounded envelope are labeled original whole-run diagnostics; they are not linked to the dates currently entered in the form.

frontend.invalidation: Any input edit, product add/remove or catalog reload invalidates token and disables submit. Ignore responses from older edit generations, even when values later return to the same text.
frontend.stale_409: Display fresh decision if structurally valid and still for the current form. Require a new explicit click; never retry submit automatically.
frontend.failed_lookup: Display the API error and keep Run disabled. Do not fall back to assuming NEW.
frontend.power_bi: DAX passes selected parameters to the local form; live cache decisions are not inferred in DAX. Imported cube result pages need a requested-window identity to show reused shorter windows.

messages.REUSE: Dùng kết quả đã có trong khoảng ngày yêu cầu
messages.EXTEND: Chạy tiếp phần ngày còn thiếu
messages.NEW: Chạy mới theo cấu hình đã chọn
messages.NO_MATCH: Chưa có kết quả khớp toàn bộ cấu hình.
messages.CONFIG_MISMATCH: Cấu hình khác kết quả đã lưu; cần chạy mới.
messages.CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE: Không có checkpoint hợp lệ để chạy tiếp.
messages.STALE_LOOKUP: Dữ liệu hoặc kế hoạch đã thay đổi. Xem lại quyết định rồi bấm nút lần nữa.
messages.UNVERIFIED_RESULT_SCOPE: Chưa xác minh được kết quả cho đúng khoảng ngày yêu cầu; chưa hiển thị KPI toàn lượt chạy thay thế.
